title: Mounted Ambush hit moves one shared anchor and restores seat height

verification.actor: One current mounted Cyndaquil (155) and one current Wild Weepinbell (70) on Route 29.
verification.trigger: Mount Cyndaquil through its native party path, then keep input neutral for 150 completed game frames while Weepinbell performs ordinary Ambush Hops.
verification.observable: Each hit loses20 saved rider HP and uses one shared rider/mount Jump anchor. The rider and mount stay paired with a32768-unit seat gap and restore their starting face height after knockback. No battle or recovery starts.

setupMutations.change: Use a private ROM/save copy; teleport to map 33 (585,407), prepare and mount party-slot-0 Cyndaquil, settle and bind it, then spawn Wild Weepinbell at (585,404) and bind it. Do not force motion, HP, or collision.

limits: Prepared party, mount, and Wild placement do not prove natural population selection or Select mounting.
The fixed 150-frame window observes normal Ambush motion and damage without forcing a Hop or contact.
Native paired player/mount pose and saved HP, not screen capture, decide height and hit results.

events.value: Bind current mounted Cyndaquil and Wild Weepinbell; read pre-hit paired height and 100 HP.
Observe150 neutral game frames with active Wild Ambush Hops and shared mounted Jump knockback.
Read saved/player HP and require at least one20-HP hit with restored rider and mount face heights.

stop.condition: 150 complete mounted game frames, at least one20-HP Ambush hit and shared Jump, with restored rider and mount face heights; or the first identity, motion, HP or field-control failure.

invariants: The same current mounted Cyndaquil and Wild Weepinbell remain attached and bound
Active Ambush Hop motion occurs during 150 neutral game frames; at least one hit lowers player and saved HP by 20 per accepted hit
The rider and mount use one shared Jump anchor. They stay paired with a32768-unit seat gap and restore their original face and gait heights after landing.
